name: Shio
message: 「Thank you for accompanying me in my training until so late again today.」

name: Shio
message: 「Even so, you are quite the eccentric person. Why do you bother keeping me company during my training?」

name: Shio
message: 「I-it was merely a jest? I am rather dense when it comes to such subtleties, so please do not tease me too much.」

name: Shio
message: 「S-surely I am not the only one, am I? You give these to everyone, yes?」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I am ashamed of myself for thinking there might be some special meaning behind it!」

name: Shio
message: 「W-whaaat?! O-only for me?! N-no way! Could that mean...!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I shall take my leave for today!」
